items.headline: Molecule buys Trilogy Energy Solutions
items.summary: Molecule's ETRM platform expanded its physical gas operations capability through the acquisition of Trilogy Energy Solutions, according to CTRM Center, deepening functionality for gas-focused trading desks.

items.headline: Carriers restore Red Sea routes amid Houthi risk
items.summary: Per FreightWaves, container lines are resuming Red Sea services even as Houthi-linked security risks deepen, leaving trans-Pacific spot rates elevated near peak-season levels and adding routing uncertainty for physical cargo desks.

items.headline: First Brands fallout still reshaping trade finance
items.summary: The unwinding of First Brands' factoring arrangements continues to pressure credit markets; Swiss firm Lalive has compared the off-balance-sheet structuring to the Greensill collapse, prompting renewed scrutiny of supply chain finance disclosures.

items.headline: EMIR Phase II reconciliation, REMIT portal changes loom
items.summary: UK EMIR Phase II trade-repository reconciliation is scheduled to begin this month, adding dozens of new matching fields, while ACER has confirmed the REMIT Portal will be retired in November 2026, requiring reporting-workflow updates.
